body.purpose: Interface labels, movement descriptions, and supporting copy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #172b45; color: #fff; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.72rem 1.15rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 700 1rem 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #234568; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2563a5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chart Readout
components.description: Persistent exact-value detail for the focused or tapped chart point.
components.css: .ds-chart-readout { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #d6e0ea; border-radius: 10px; background: #f7f9fb; color: #142033; font: 400 0.8rem 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-chart-readout b { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: A light, precise finance workspace that lets the owner scan period totals, category movement, and exact values on phone or computer. IBM Plex Sans, an ink-navy frame, and distinct chart series keep the visual system clear without decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper surfaces with navy structure.
Amber, coral, and blue series with visible labels.
Exact CLP readouts on hover and on focused or tapped month/day columns.

rules.name: The Series Rule
rules.body: Every chart series has a matching visible label; color reinforces the category but does not replace its name or exact value.

dos: Do preserve financial calculations and label periods explicitly.
Do keep chart detail reachable without hover.
donts: Don't rely on color alone or truncate exact amounts.
